dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

prototype_evidence.role: A, stronger EPC member versus ordered cubic B
prototype_evidence.known_prior_scope: different from known disordered BCC Im-3m Nb2TiMo experiment; not yet claimed an unreported phase globally

candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: NegativeGamma modes are predominantly translational, and the independently checked optical form is positive beyond raw printing bounds. Magnetism/SOC/disorder and full-BZ/finite-temperature stability remain beyond this nonmagnetic source approximation.
candidate.ambient_scope: Zero-pressure-target optimized models and completed sampled non-Gamma/ASR-path phonons plus positive Gamma optical compression support local near-ambient harmonic feasibility within the declared source model.
candidate.route_response: Non-isometric species-resolved network differences accompany the same-composition source EPC contrast at ten common widths; different reciprocal grids remain an explicit numerical confound.
candidate.next_action: Matched reciprocal-resolution refinement must preserve A>B and optical positivity; reversal or adverse structural/magnetic evidence revises this screen. Source association or inconclusive refinement leaves the research hypothesis unresolved.

seven_criteria.identity: Exact ordered source sites, canonical SCF input, neutral spin1/noSOC model and SCF/PH/dyn association are linked. Experimental conditions remain unknown.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Non-isometric species-resolved network differences accompany the same-composition source EPC contrast at ten common widths; different reciprocal grids remain an explicit numerical confound.
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: Direct conventional source EPC gives A>B at every retained width in both the directory and raw-q aggregation; this is a bounded source-protocol benefit.
seven_criteria.ambient_feasibility: Zero-pressure-target optimized models and completed sampled non-Gamma/ASR-path phonons plus positive Gamma optical compression support local near-ambient harmonic feasibility within the declared source model.
seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: NegativeGamma modes are predominantly translational, and the independently checked optical form is positive beyond raw printing bounds. Magnetism/SOC/disorder and full-BZ/finite-temperature stability remain beyond this nonmagnetic source approximation.
seven_criteria.novelty: New to the reviewed catalogue as an exact ordered geometry-route hypothesis; known experimental disorderedBCC Nb2TiMo is a distinct object. Published source predictions are acknowledged and worldwide first discovery is not claimed.
seven_criteria.decision: Matched reciprocal-resolution refinement must preserve A>B and optical positivity; reversal or adverse structural/magnetic evidence revises this screen. Source association or inconclusive refinement leaves the research hypothesis unresolved.

candidate.newness_scope: new-to-reviewed-catalogue ordered geometry hypothesis; literature-derived, not first discovery
